mehrheitsweg.einstieg: Compare concrete paths: whose votes you can win, what you promise and which partners will exact a political price.
mehrheitsweg.keinWeg: No valid negotiation path is available at present. Check implementation obstacles and faction demands; individual clauses and talks remain available below.
mehrheitsweg.keineMehrheit: The available compromises and your political capital cannot yet secure a majority. These paths gain votes; the remaining shortfall stays visible.
mehrheitsweg.keinZuwachs: No additional votes compared with the current draft.
mehrheitsweg.budgetDelta: {n}% of GDP versus the current draft
mehrheitsweg.zeit: Vote on {datum} · {vorlauf} days of preparation · {dauer} days in force.
mehrheitsweg.duldung: The confidence-and-supply agreement with {parteien} expires by the vote. The lost votes are already included.
mehrheitsweg.koalitionsRisiko: {parteien}: the demand remains unmet. These partners react negatively even if the vote succeeds.
mehrheitsweg.keinKoalitionsVerlust: Under current conditions, this vote would cause no additional loss of coalition willingness or partner loyalty.
mehrheitsweg.bedingt: These reactions apply if the bill passes and political conditions remain unchanged. Talks only increase votes for this bill. Changes are capped at 0 and 100.
mehrheitsweg.hinweis: Adopting a path amends the draft and conducts the listed talks. Budget funds are charged only if the bill passes. The vote takes place automatically on the displayed date; majorities can change before then. Vote gains refer to individual seats, not lasting support from an entire faction.
mehrheitsweg.veraltet: The negotiating position has changed. Nothing was adopted and no capital was spent. Compare the recalculated paths.
mehrheitsweg.uebernommen: Negotiation path adopted for “{name}”: {klauseln}. New talks: {parteien}. {pk} PC spent; currently {ja} yes votes expected. The bill remains under deliberation until the vote.
